ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region on the left lobe, bordered by a thick low-intensity black margin; the right lobe and central peduncle region are predominantly low-intensity black with internal high-intensity linear streaks and punctate white clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-estimated angle of 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:5 relative to the inner lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the medial trailing edges, transitioning to irregular, high-amplitude jagged variations and protruding barnacle clusters at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes leading toward the median notch, with convex curvature observed at the outer lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast, three-dimensional pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the distal tips and medial-distal trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of parallel and intersecting high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) localized primarily within the black pigment zones of the central and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple sets of tooth rake marks across the central-right surface and significant barnacle colonization on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive, complex black geometric pigmentation pattern shaped roughly like an 'H' or 'K' symbol located within the white field of the left lobe.
